howItWorks.summary: How it all works (and whether the client has to sign up)
howItWorks.step1: You onboard the brand here — the client doesn't need to be around.
howItWorks.step2: The brand is created under your account. The client can't see it yet.
howItWorks.step3: You hand it over to their e-mail — at the bottom of this screen, or any time later in Settings → Manage.
howItWorks.step4: The client creates the account themselves — we can't create it for them (address confirmation and consent to the terms). The invitation pre-fills the code and e-mail, so all that's left is a password or Google.
howItWorks.step5: On their first sign-in the brand is assigned automatically. It has to be the same e-mail you handed over to.

handoff.title: Hand over to the customer
handoff.body: The brand is still under your account. Enter the customer's e-mail — they will see it in their dashboard and pass the beta gate. If they don't have an account yet, an invitation goes out and they get the brand on their first sign-up. You can also hand it over later in Settings → Manage.
